assets.public/images/artwork/study-night.webp:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: production dark-theme website background for a study/preparation map hero, landscape 1536x1024.
Input image: the approved light study-phase-rosettes background, used as composition and geometric style reference.
Primary request: regenerate this repeating sculptural rosette pattern as a genuinely designed nighttime counterpart. Preserve the recognizable arrangement, scale, broad curved interlocking bands, repeated spiral/leaf rosette geometry, and fine crisp edges. Re-render its materials and lighting in the site's dark palette, rather than applying a black overlay to the pale image.
Color palette: deep graphite aubergine #17151d and #24212d for shadows and base, muted plum #302b3a and #453653 for broad band faces, restrained violet #67507f and #8f72b0 only on narrow upper edges. Predominantly deep graphite and violet; no pink/red cast. No pale lavender or white surfaces.
Style/medium: precise optical geometry with elegant shallow sculptural depth, matte folded satin/paper-like surfaces, soft directional lighting that reveals the repeated bands. Rich clean dark colors and clear shape separation, tasteful and calm behind an opaque text panel.
Composition: full-bleed repeated pattern throughout the image, same approximate rosette size and spacing as the reference; no empty center, no text panel painted into the image.
Constraints: preserve the project's geometric identity; the asset must look finished when displayed directly at full opacity without a CSS tint/filter. No words, logos, UI, frame, watermark, neon, glow, metallic shine, fog, faded gray veil, white lines or rainbow colors.
